title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 5

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the new form be introduced?
tasks.audioText: The stores department is introducing a new component record form next week. The form includes the part number, description, quantity received and date of inspection. Students practising stores documentation should collect a sample from the instructor on Wednesday. The exercise will use training components only and will not involve live stock.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which detail is included on the form?
tasks.audioText: The stores department is introducing a new component record form next week. The form includes the part number, description, quantity received and date of inspection. Students practising stores documentation should collect a sample from the instructor on Wednesday. The exercise will use training components only and will not involve live stock.

tasks.prompt: A stores assistant received a delivery of bearings for a training project. She checked the part numbers against the purchase list and counted the packages before signing the delivery note. One box had a damaged label, so she recorded the problem and asked the supervisor to confirm the contents. The assistant did not add the box to the available stock until the details were checked. Reading 1. What did the assistant compare with the purchase list?
Why did she delay adding one box to stock?
options: Because the label was damaged and the contents needed confirmation

tasks.prompt: The delivery note ___ after the package count is checked.
Choose TWO details that help identify a component in a stores record.
options: The colour of the office curtains

tasks.prompt: A part number on a label is unclear. What should you do?
options: Enter the number that looks most likely.
Ask the supervisor to confirm the part number before recording it.
Ignore the label and store the item.
Change the number to match another box.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of component records in a logical order.
options: Compare the delivery with the purchase list
Confirm unclear details before updating stock
correctOrder: Compare the delivery with the purchase list
Confirm unclear details before updating stock

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how accurate component records help a workshop or stores department. Include part numbers, quantities and discrepancy reporting.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); accurate technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
